description: Ingest n8n documentation from GitHub clone and llms-full.txt into structured markdown with metadata
steps: Read all .md files from n8n-docs-source/docs/
Parse frontmatter and extract metadata (category, tags, difficulty, related nodes)
Chunk documents semantically (by headers, code blocks, sections)
Generate embeddings for each chunk using text-embedding-3-small
Store in Qdrant with full metadata payload
Verify search works for test queries

description: Build LLM query interface for n8n knowledge base
steps: Create query router (classify: how-to, node-ref, troubleshooting, architecture, best-practices)
Implement hybrid search (vector + keyword + metadata filters)
Build response formatter with citations and code examples
Add related workflows and next steps suggestions
Test with 20 diverse queries from each category

description: Build n8n workflow analyzer (JSON → structured analysis)
steps: Parse workflow JSON: nodes, connections, credentials, settings
Identify trigger type and extract API endpoint spec
Detect AI agents, their models, tools, and prompts
Map data flow and identify required DB tables
Extract required credentials and environment variables
Calculate complexity score and estimate SaaS components
Output analysis JSON schema

description: Create SaaS template: AI Tool (single workflow → Next.js API)
steps: Design Next.js 14 App Router structure with (auth) and (dashboard) groups
Implement n8n webhook endpoint handler with validation
Add Clerk authentication with organization support
Create Supabase database schema (users, workflows, executions, api_keys)
Build dashboard: workflow list, execution history, API key management
Add Stripe billing integration (subscription webhooks → n8n)
Create landing page using saas-landing-pages framework
Add deployment configuration for Vercel + n8n (Docker/Railway)

description: Build workflow-to-code generator (analysis JSON → SaaS project)
steps: Map workflow analysis to template parameters
Generate Next.js project with templated files
Create n8n workflow import script
Generate TypeScript types from workflow I/O
Create environment variable template (.env.example)
Generate README with deployment instructions
Output complete project to generated-saas/<name>/

description: Set up OpenChamber project with n8n, GitHub, Vercel, Supabase MCP servers
steps: Configure OpenChamber project directory
Add n8n MCP server (workflow CRUD, executions, credentials)
Add GitHub MCP server (repo, PR, issues)
Add Vercel MCP server (deployments, domains)
Add Supabase MCP server (database, auth, storage)
Add Stripe MCP server (products, subscriptions, webhooks)
Verify all MCP connections work from test session

description: Define and register OpenChamber agents (architect, implementer, verifier, researcher, reviewer)
steps: Create .opencode/agents/architect.md with n8n MCP tools
Create .opencode/agents/implementer.md with write/shell/github MCP
Create .opencode/agents/verifier.md with playwright/vercel MCP
Create .opencode/agents/researcher.md with websearch/n8n-docs MCP
Create .opencode/agents/reviewer.md with thermo-nuclear review
Update AGENTS.md with routing rules
Test each agent with sample task

description: Build n8n synchronization workflows (docs sync, workflow→code, deploy pipeline)
steps: Create n8n workflow: Daily documentation sync (cron → llms-full.txt → diff → Qdrant)
Create n8n workflow: Workflow change webhook → analyze → GitHub PR
Create n8n workflow: GitHub push → Vercel deploy → health check → update n8n webhooks
Create n8n workflow: OpenChamber session events → update project state
Deploy all sync workflows to n8n instance
Test end-to-end: edit workflow in n8n → see PR → see deployment

description: Implement verification gates for generated SaaS
steps: Create init.sh that starts n8n, Next.js dev server, Supabase local
Build verifier agent test suite: auth flow, webhook execution, billing webhook
Add thermo-nuclear code review to PR pipeline
Add Playwright smoke tests for critical user journeys
Configure git hooks: pre-commit (lint, typecheck), pre-push (tests)
Write CLAUDE.md with project overview and key commands
Create CONTRIBUTING.md with agent workflow guide
Document n8n wiki query API with examples
Document SaaS factory CLI usage
Create troubleshooting guide for common sync issues
Record video walkthrough of full pipeline
